author: Chris Schommer
title: J.T. Ginn battles control in win over Dodgers
desc: J.T. Ginn allowed one earned run on three hits and five walks while striking out four over six innings in Wednesday's 7-1 win over the Dodgers.
impact: Ginn has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six contests. The right-hander offers manager Mark Kotsay one of the more stable starting options in an underperforming Athletics rotation, carrying a 3.04 ERA and 1.23 WHIP to go with a 7-4 record and 2.00 K/BB ratio across 19 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Goodman goes deep in win over Marlins
desc: Hunter Goodman went 1-for-4 in Wednesday's 6-3 win over the Marlins with a two-run home run.
impact: Goodman has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in four of his last six contests. The catcher remains one of the more explosive bats in an inconsistent Rockies lineup to this point, carrying an .853 OPS with 27 home runs, 50 RBI, 54 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 81 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mickey Moniak racks up near-cycle in win over Marlins
desc: Mickey Moniak went 3-for-4 in a 6-3 win over the Marlins with a home run, a triple, a double, two runs scored, and three RBI.
impact: Moniak continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in five of his last six contests. The outfielder has offered manager Warren Schaeffer  one of the more impactful options in the Rockies lineup, slashing .271 with 14 homers, 35 RBI, 25 runs scored, and one stolen base through 52 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros homers in win over Marlins
desc: Kyle Karros went 1-for-3 in Wednesday's win over the Marlins with a solo home run and two runs scored.
impact: Karros has heated up at the plate, collecting hits in eight of his last nine contests. The infielder remains one of many streaky bats in the Rockies lineup to this point, batting .258 with six home runs, 26 RBI, 40 runs scored, and two stolen bases through 82 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Freeland solid on mound in win over Marlins
desc: Kyle Freeland allowed two earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out seven over five innings in Wednesday's win over the Marlins.
impact: Freeland continues an underwhelming stretch in the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in 10 of his last 12 contests. The left-hander cannot be trusted as part of a dismal Rockies rotation to this point, posting a 7.25 ERA and 1.60 WHIP with a 2-7 record and .922 OPS allowed across 15 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Yordan Alvarez racks up three hits in loss to Twins
desc: Yordan Alvarez went 3-for-4 in loss to the Twins with a walk.
impact: Alvarez has provided mixed results at the plate of late, collecting hits in five of his last 10 contests. The 28-year-old continues to reward manager Joe Espada with one of the few explosive bats in a streaky Astros lineup, carrying a 1.053 OPS with 26 home runs, 60 RBI, 59 runs scored, and one stolen base through 87 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tatsuya Imai implodes early in loss to Twins
desc: Tatsuya Imai allowed five earned runs on four hits and five walks while striking out two over 1 1/3 innings in Wednesday's loss to the Twins.
impact: Imai has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last four contests. The right-hander continues to struggle with inconsistent command despite flashing top-tier stuff at times for manager Joe Espada, posting a 6.14 ERA and 1.47 WHIP with a 2.00 K/BB ratio and a 5-4 record across 12 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sam Antonacci homers in loss to Orioles
desc: Sam Antonacci went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Orioles with a solo home run.
impact: Antonacci continues a impactful stretch at the plate, recording hits in 16 of his last 19 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more dynamic lineup options for manager Will Venable, slashing .295 with five home runs, 23 RBI, 44 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 66 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Noah Schultz struggles with control in loss to Orioles
desc: Noah Schultz allowed three earned runs on two hits and four walks while striking out seven over 4 1/3 innings in Wednesday's loss to the Orioles.
impact: Schultz has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last five trips to the mound. The left-hander remains difficult to trust every fifth day while continuing to battle dismal command for manager Will Venable, posting a 5.86 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 2-5 record and 1.5 K/BB ratio through nine starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Garrett Mitchell flirts with cycle in win over Reds
desc: Garrett Mitchell went 4-for-4 in a win over the Reds with two doubles, a triple, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Mitchell continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last six contests. The outfielder provides manager Pat Murphy with another reliable option as part of a versatile Brewers lineup, slashing .264 with six home runs, 39 RBI, 35 runs, and six steals through 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shane Drohan steady on mound in no-decision
desc: Shane Drohan allowed two earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out seven over 5 2/3 innings in Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Reds.
impact: Drohan has settled down on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last three contests. The left-hander has provided manager Pat Murphy with another mostly stable option as part of a strong Brewers pitching staff, posting a 3.12 ERA and 1.23 WHIP with a 3-2 record and 9.2 K/9 ratio through 17 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Trevor Megill slams door for another save in win over Reds
desc: Trevor Megill allowed one hit while striking out one over a scoreless inning to earn the save in Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Reds.
impact: Megill continues an impressive stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in 17 of his last 18 trips to the mound. The right-hander has returned to form as a reliable closing option for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 3.27 ERA and 0.97 WHIP with 12 saves and seven holds across 34 appearances.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Carson Benge homers and doubles
desc: Carson Benge went 2-for-4 with a two-run home run and a double Wednesday against the Blue Jays. His opposite-field homer traveled more than 400 feet and was one of three hard-hit balls he produced in the game.
impact: Benge is batting .259 with 10 home runs and 11 stolen bases after a difficult opening month. He has posted a .286/.333/.516 slash line with seven homers over the last 30 days, making his recent production stronger than his season-long numbers suggest.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Freddy Peralta allows five runs in loss
desc: Freddy Peralta took the loss Wednesday against the Blue Jays after allowing five runs on seven hits and three walks over four innings. He struck out four. Toronto scored four times with two outs in the third inning, highlighted by Sean Keys' first career home run.
impact: Peralta continues to struggle with his command and breaking pitches. He owns a 4.81 ERA with 92 strikeouts and 38 walks across 95.1 innings, with his next start potentially coming Monday against Atlanta or Tuesday against Kansas City.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. swipes two bases in loss to Tigers
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. went 2-for-5 in Wednesday's loss to the Tigers with a double, one run scored, and two stolen bases.
impact: Chisholm Jr. has provided mixed results at the plate of late, picking up hits in five of his last 10 contests. The second baseman remains one of the more streaky, yet explosive options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .225 with 12 home runs, 33 RBI, 43 runs scored, and 26 stolen bases across 82 games.
